history.name: Raptors -6.5 (Alt Spread)

history.lesson: Sharp-money move was right, but the margin was thin; prefer one fewer point.

history.name: Hawks -11.5 (Alt Spread)
history.whyExplanation: Missed: Atlanta won by only 4 against a depleted Indiana team.

history.name: Short-Handed Opponents
history.whyExplanation: Lost 0-3: Hawks won by only 4, Pelicans beat Memphis in OT, Washington beat Orlando outright.

history.lesson: Monday was an upset night (7 NBA favorites lost or failed to cover). Prices of -150 to -250 are only 60-70% and should not fill a 25-leg ticket.

history.whyExplanation: Lost: 22 of 25 hit. Misses: Brown (-410) lost to New Hampshire, Marist (-320) lost to Dartmouth, Mavericks ML (-335) lost to Sacramento.
history.lesson: Even -300 to -400 college favorites lose; Ivy/MAAC early-season games are volatile. Use -800 or longer for the heavy ladder.

history.lesson: A -1100 home favorite in UEFA Conference League can still draw a supposed mismatch (Atalanta 1-1 Kairat). Class-gap soccer MLs are not locks — prefer double chance unless the opponent is truly amateur-tier.

history.name: Home Ice +1.5 Trio
history.whyExplanation: LOST. Penguins got blown out 6-2 by Boston; Canadiens and Blue Jackets both covered +1.5.
history.lesson: NHL home +1.5 remains strong (2/3 here) but a true mismatch/home team in freefall (PIT) can still get run. Prefer +1.5 when the home side is at least average.

history.name: Prime-Time Cushions
history.whyExplanation: WON at +108. All four cushions hit: JAX -2.5 by 23, GS +4.5 win, COL +1.5 and EDM +1.5 each lost by 1.
history.lesson: Mixed-sport cushion parlays with real points (NFL -2.5 mismatch, NBA +4.5, NHL +1.5) paid. NHL +1.5 home/road cushions continue to cash.

history.name: College Locks Ladder
history.whyExplanation: WON at -473. All 11 college moneylines at -3500 or longer hit. Seton Hall was the closest (67-60).
history.lesson: College MLs at -1800 or longer are now 27-0 when followed. Keep as the Best Shot / ladder backbone.

history.lesson: A road dog cushion against an elite home team (KC) is not a safe leg; mismatches like this run away, the same as the NBA mismatch lesson.

history.name: Las Vegas Raiders +7.5
history.whyExplanation: Lost: SF won 38-17 by 21.
history.lesson: Bad road dogs at elite hosts lose big; don't take dog cushions on bad teams in NFL either.

history.name: Campus Moneyline Trio
history.whyExplanation: LOST. Tulane fell 87-85 at home to Jackson State. Tulsa won 94-75; Oregon still plays Friday.
history.lesson: Even -950 college home favorites can lose opening-week games to mid-majors. Prefer -1800+ only, and be wary of G5 hosts vs motivated SWAC/MEAC visitors.

history.name: Sunday Cushions + Utah
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Utah +1.5 and Detroit +1.5 hit, but Arizona +7.5 missed (lost 17-3).
history.lesson: Same Cardinals lesson: dog cushions on a weak offense are the leak. Bought-down favorites (Detroit) cashed again.

history.name: Friday College Locks
history.whyExplanation: WON at -2821. All four Power hosts at -10000/-20000 hit: Alabama 101-86, UNC 109-70, Ohio State 89-65, Kentucky 89-80.
history.lesson: College MLs at -1800+ continue to cash as lock-parlay backbone (now 31-0 on dedicated lock tickets).

history.lesson: Extreme NBA dog cushions (≥+15.5) can still cash in competitive losses. Keep ≥+9.5 minimum; bigger is safer vs elite.

history.name: Virginia Tech +4.5
history.whyExplanation: LOST. SMU 51 VT 28 — Hokies got blown out on the road and never threatened +4.5.
history.lesson: Small CFB road cushions (+4.5) are not high-prob when the home side is motivated and healthy. Prefer ≥+9.5 for dog singles.

history.name: Nevada +8.5
history.whyExplanation: LOST. New Mexico 31 Nevada 3 — home dog got crushed; +8.5 never had a chance.
history.lesson: Mountain West home dogs can still get run. +8.5 was under the ≥+9.5 cushion rule spirit — need more points or skip soft home dogs.

history.name: Home Ice +1.5 Trio
history.whyExplanation: LOST. Buffalo and Minnesota covered easily; Calgary lost 5-3 (by 2) and missed +1.5.
history.lesson: NHL home +1.5 remains strong (2/3) but struggling home clubs (CGY) can lose by 2+. Prefer average-or-better home teams only.

history.name: Friday College Locks
history.whyExplanation: WON at -5425. All three Power MLs hit. Wisconsin was the closest (73-64).
history.lesson: College MLs at -1800+ on dedicated lock parlays are now 34-0. Keep as the safest backbone.

history.name: Campus Alt Favorites

history.whyExplanation: Won: BUF won 23-6 at Minnesota (needed no worse than a 6-point loss) and SA won by 26 at Phoenix.
history.lesson: Fading a backup QB (Wentz) with a bought-down road favorite and giving an elite NBA favorite 10 points of cushion both cashed easily.

history.name: Islanders Road Ice + Cavs Cushion

legs.event: New York Islanders @ San Jose Sharks

history.whyExplanation: Lost: NYI lost 3-2 in a shootout (+1.5 covered), but Cleveland lost by 12 at Charlotte (+1.5 missed).
history.lesson: An NBA road favorite on a long-ish trip vs a young, fast home team can lose outright; Charlotte had been better at home than its record. NBA road favorites at +1.5 need a healthy, clearly better team AND a check on recent form (CLE had been inconsistent). Road NHL favorites at +1.5 keep covering.

history.name: Oilers Home Ice + Warriors Cushion

legs.event: New Orleans Pelicans @ Golden State Warriors

history.whyExplanation: Won: EDM 3-1 and GSW by 51 over a Pelicans team on a back-to-back.
history.lesson: Back-to-back fade plus home NHL favorite +1.5 both easy.

history.name: Pistons Cushion + Buckeyes Bought-Down
history.whyExplanation: Lost: DET won by 11 (+1.5 hit), but Ohio State beat Marshall by only 10 (needed 17).
history.lesson: A Power-4 host vs a decent mid-major (Marshall, Sun Belt) is not the same as vs a SWAC/NEC team. 9 points off a -25.5 line still failed. Against competent mid-majors, cushion must be at least 12-14 points, or skip the alt.

history.name: Sooners + Tigers Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Auburn won by 22 (hit), but Oklahoma beat North Alabama by only 9 (needed 19).
history.lesson: Same as Ohio State: big main spreads (-27.5) vs mid-major visitors with real guards can stay close. The 8-9 point buy-down only works when the visitor is truly bottom-tier (SWAC, NEC, MEAC, D-II-level).

history.name: Flames + Tigers Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Clemson won by 15 (hit), but UIC beat UNC Greensboro by exactly 10 (needed 11).
history.lesson: UIC vs UNCG was a mid-major vs mid-major game; -19.5 was inflated. No bought-down alts in mid-major vs mid-major games.

history.name: West Coast Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Won: Stanford by 18 and Oregon State by 10 (needed 8).
history.lesson: Power/strong host vs weak visitor held, though Oregon State was close; keep cushions at 9+.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 9 of 12 legs hit. Cincinnati +1.5 (lost 63-61 to Minnesota), Canucks +1.5 (lost 3-1 to Philadelphia) and Raptors +4.5 (lost by 16 to Memphis) missed. All seven college favorites and the Rockets covered.
history.lesson: The three misses were the three closest-to-coin-flip legs (-380/-225/-245 on near pick'em games). Big college favorites bought down vs low-major teams went 7/7. A day-long Best Shot should be built ONLY from the -1000+ college moneylines and big-cushion low-major alts, never pick'em-game cushions.

history.name: Longhorns + Vols Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Won: Texas by 31 (needed 29) and Tennessee by 23 (needed 22).
history.lesson: Both won but by only 2 and 1 points more than needed; the 9-point cushion was nearly all used. vs SWAC/Big South visitors it still held.

history.name: Huskies + Wildcats Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Won: UConn by 42 and Northwestern by 17.
history.lesson: Elite host vs NEC team plus Big Ten host vs Patriot League both held comfortably.

history.name: Blazers + Pirates Home Cushions
history.whyExplanation: Won: UAB by 28 and Seton Hall by 6.
history.lesson: Big host vs MEAC team and better-team +4.5 both cashed.

history.name: Mavs Cushion + Hurricanes Bought-Down
history.whyExplanation: Won: Dallas won by 3 (+5.5) and Miami by 38.
history.lesson: Giving a back-to-back home favorite 9 points of cushion instead of the spread was right: Dallas only won by 3.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Won: all 6 legs hit (Lakers/Hawks went over, Georgia, Mississippi State, DePaul, O'Connell, Shang). But it was only -125, so it paid $4 on $5.
history.lesson: A short Best Shot of near-certain legs cashes, but the payout is tiny. Plan the morning/afternoon split so the 3 PM Best Shot gets enough strong evening legs to reach +1000.

history.name: Heat Cushion + Avalanche Road Ice
history.whyExplanation: Won: Miami won by 6 at depleted 1-9 Utah (+1.5) and Colorado won 6-3 at Toronto.
history.lesson: Favorite vs a depleted bottom team with 10 points of cushion plus a road NHL favorite at +1.5 both held. Note Miami only won by 6 as an 8.5 favorite: the cushion, not the spread, is what made it safe.

history.name: Knicks Bought-Down + Devils Road Ice
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Knicks won by 32 (hit), but the Devils lost 4-2 at Winnipeg with backup Jake Allen in net (+1.5 missed by one goal; the second Jets goal was decisive).
history.lesson: We flagged the backup goalie and still used the leg. An NHL road favorite starting its backup goalie against its opponent's starter has no goalie edge, so it fails our own "+1.5 only with the goalie edge" rule. Skip those.

history.name: Cyclones + Musketeers Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Won: Iowa State by 37 (needed 27) and Xavier by 45 (needed 27).
history.lesson: Buy-downs vs visitors that already lost by 50+ (SWAC Southern, Detroit Mercy) were comfortable.

history.name: Wolfpack + Rebels Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Won: NC State by 34 (needed 11) and Ole Miss by 40 (needed 18).
history.lesson: Power host vs low-major visitor at a moderate main line (-19.5 to -26.5) held easily.

history.name: Broncos MACtion + Scarlet Knights
history.whyExplanation: Won: Western Michigan won 42-14 at Akron and Rutgers by 37.
history.lesson: MAC road favorite bought 10 down vs the worst conference team plus a Big Ten host vs NJIT: both easy.

history.name: Deacons + Friars Bought-Down Hosts
history.whyExplanation: Won: Wake by 18 (needed 10) and Providence by 23 (needed 23, covered by half a point).
history.lesson: Providence -22.5 covered by just 0.5. Main lines above -30 swing a lot; a 9-point buy-down from -31.5 is thinner than it looks.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 12 of 15 legs hit. Georgetown -19.5 (won by only 5 vs Delaware State), TCU -25.5 (won by 8 in 2OT vs UL Monroe) and BYU -19.5 (won by 16 vs Queens) missed. All moneylines, the Celtics/76ers total and the other buy-downs hit.
history.lesson: All three misses were buy-downs from mega-spreads (-27.5 to -34.5 main lines). Those games are high-variance: starters sit, benches play, and the margin can collapse. Buy-downs from a -20 to -26 main held 10/10 Tuesday, but from -27.5 and up went 4/7 (Georgetown, TCU and BYU missed; Iowa State, Xavier, Arizona and UVA hit). In a 15-leg ticket, use moneylines for mega-spread games, not alt spreads.

history.name: Wild + Blues Ice Cushions

legs.event: Detroit Red Wings @ St. Louis Blues

history.whyExplanation: Won: Minnesota won 2-1 in OT at Montreal and St. Louis beat Detroit 3-2.
history.lesson: Both legs were +1.5 on favorites with the starting-goalie edge; both games were one-goal games, so the moneyline would also have won but the +1.5 removed the OT risk.

history.name: Cavaliers Bought-Down + Magic/Kings Over
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Virginia won by 34 (hit), but Orlando-Sacramento finished 107-100, 207 total (Over 209.5 missed by 3).
history.lesson: A short-handed team (Orlando without Banchero, Suggs and Isaac) can drag even a 13-point alt total under; Orlando had already gone under 210 in 3 of 9 games. A team that misses the alt total in 30%+ of its games is not a big-cushion total. Require both teams to clear it in roughly 90%+ of games, and avoid totals involving teams missing 2+ primary scorers.

history.name: Commodores ML + Clippers/Suns Over
history.whyExplanation: Won: Vanderbilt won by 24 and Clippers/Suns scored 243 (needed 211).
history.lesson: A 14-point total cushion where 14 of 18 combined games cleared it held easily; moneyline vs a competent mid-major was correct.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Won: all 5 home moneylines hit (Baylor, Arizona State, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico), but at -493 it paid only $1.01 on $5.
history.lesson: Near-lock moneylines win but pay almost nothing. Plan the day so the stronger card has the price.

history.name: Lakers + Golden Hurricane Bought-Down
history.whyExplanation: Won: the Lakers won by 11 at Milwaukee (needed 5) and Tulsa beat Oral Roberts by 9 (needed 9, exactly enough).
history.lesson: Both 9-point buy-downs held, but Tulsa covered by zero points: an AAC host projected by 16.5 won by only 9. Model margins vs low-majors run hot in November; Tulsa -8.5 was the thinnest kind of leg.

history.name: Spurs Bought-Down + Aggies Cushion
history.whyExplanation: Lost: UC Davis won by 12 (hit), but San Antonio won only 124-119 at Chicago, so Spurs -5.5 missed by half a point. The Bulls led 41-29 after one quarter.
history.lesson: An NBA road favorite bought down to a minus number still has to win by margin. Even an elite 9-2 team on a 10-game win streak won a road game against a 1-8 team by only 5. For NBA 2-leg parlays, put the cushion on the plus side (+1.5 or better) for road favorites, or skip.

history.name: Knicks Home Cushion + Paladins ML
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Furman won by 13 (hit), but Cleveland beat the Knicks 115-107 (Knicks +6.5 missed by 1.5). Harden scored a season-high 32. Josh Hart, listed out, actually played 26 minutes.
history.lesson: A -4.5 home favorite on a back-to-back against a talented team (Mitchell, Harden, Mobley, Allen) is close to a coin flip, and 11 points of cushion did not make it a near lock. Cleveland's 1-4 road record hid a roster that is better than the Knicks on paper. Small NBA favorites (-3.5 to -4.5) on a back-to-back are out of 2-leg parlays.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 4 of 5 moneylines hit (Notre Dame, South Carolina, Boise State and Colorado State all won by 16+), but Seattle (-3000) lost 86-59 at home to UTSA.
history.lesson: The first -1800+ college moneyline loss on record (previously 34-0 in lock parlays). UTSA is an AAC team visiting a WAC/WCC-level host; the price came from UTSA's weak opener (beat VMI by 2), not from a true tier gap. Near-lock moneylines need a real conference/quality gap: Power or top mid-major host vs a bottom-75 visitor (T-Rank 290+). A visitor from an equal or higher league is never a lock regardless of the price.

history.name: Oilers Home Ice + Rockets Home Cushion
history.whyExplanation: Won: Edmonton beat Philadelphia 3-2 in OT and Houston beat Golden State by 7 (needed to lose by no more than 3).
history.lesson: Goalie-edge NHL home favorite at +1.5 plus a rested, healthier NBA home favorite with 10 points of cushion both held.

history.name: Golden Knights Home Ice + Celtics Big Cushion
history.whyExplanation: Won: Vegas beat Utah 5-3 and Boston won 98-93 at Toronto (+7.5 was not needed).
history.lesson: Goalie-edge +1.5 (now 6-1 the last three days on favorites with the edge) plus the clearly better NBA team with 13 points of cushion vs a depleted host.

history.name: Nuggets + Pelicans Cushions
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Denver won by 5 at Memphis (hit), but Brooklyn routed New Orleans 145-111 (Pelicans +7.5 missed by 26). Egor Demin returned for Brooklyn and the Nets scored 83 in the first half.
history.lesson: The Pelicans were only -3.5 at home vs a 2-8 team: the market was saying these teams were close, and New Orleans itself is a weak team. A small favorite that is not clearly good is not "the better team". NBA cushions need a favorite of -6.5 or more, or a favorite with a proven record, not just a bad opponent. Also check returning players (Demin) the day of the game.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Won: Grand Canyon won by 28, Orlando won by 15 at Utah (+12.5 not needed) and Anaheim lost only 4-2 to Nashville (+2.5 covered). Paid $1.45 on $5 at -345.
history.lesson: The three-leg safety ticket won, but at -345 it pays almost nothing. Nashville's second goal margin was the closest call (+2.5 held by half a goal).

history.name: Pistons Road Cushion + Patriots Bought-Down
history.whyExplanation: Won: Detroit won 144-140 in double overtime at Washington (+1.5 not needed, but it was a coin flip late in regulation), and George Mason beat UMKC 76-68, covering -7.5 by half a point.
history.lesson: Both legs cashed but both were close. Washington on a back-to-back still pushed Detroit to 2OT, so +1.5 on a road favorite was the right side of the number. George Mason (projected by ~16.5) won by only 8: low-major buy-downs keep landing right at the number in November (Tulsa covered by zero Wednesday). Raise the projection bar to buy-down + 7, or use the moneyline.

history.name: Wild Road Ice + Tigers ML
history.whyExplanation: Won: Minnesota won 5-2 at Toronto and Towson beat Loyola Maryland 90-60.
history.lesson: A goalie-edge road favorite at +1.5 against a slumping home team, plus a CAA host vs a bottom-25 visitor (true tier gap). Both won comfortably. Keep this template.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Won: all six home moneylines hit (Rhode Island by 20, Indiana by 24, Minnesota by 30, High Point by 29, Penn State by 15, Bowling Green by 12). Paid $0.51 on $5 at -971.
history.lesson: The tier-gap rule (lower-league, T-Rank ~200+ visitors) went 6/6 one day after the Seattle loss. It is a safety ticket, not a $5K ticket; at -971 it pays almost nothing.

history.name: Devils + Senators Goalie-Edge Ice
history.whyExplanation: Won: New Jersey beat Washington 5-2 and Ottawa beat Colorado 4-3 in overtime.
history.lesson: Waiting for the confirmed starter (Hellebuyck) before using the Devils was right. Ullmark .945 vs Wedgewood .867, the biggest goalie edge on the board, won in OT; +1.5 was the right protection in a pick'em.

history.name: Islanders + Blues Goalie-Edge Ice

legs.event: New York Islanders @ Los Angeles Kings

history.whyExplanation: Won: the Islanders won 5-2 at Los Angeles and St. Louis won 1-0 in a shootout at Utah (on a back-to-back).
history.lesson: Goalie edge plus a tired or struggling host. Hofer pitched a shutout against a Utah team on the second night of a back-to-back.

history.name: Stars Home Ice + Suns Big Cushion

legs.actual: WPG 8-3 at DAL (Oettinger 6 GA on 27 shots, pulled)

history.whyExplanation: Lost: Phoenix beat Charlotte 101-96 (+4.5 not needed), but Winnipeg routed Dallas 8-3. Jake Oettinger allowed 6 goals on 27 shots and was pulled.
history.lesson: Dallas had the smallest goalie edge of the five NHL +1.5 legs (Oettinger .906 vs Skinner .883, about .023), and Oettinger is not an elite-form starter this year. The NHL +1.5 legs that won had a wider gap or a tired opponent. Rule: goalie edge of about .025+ and the favorite's starter at .910+, or an opponent on a back-to-back. The Suns leg was also closer than it should have been (won by 5 vs a team missing three starters), so the 11-point cushion was justified.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Won: West Virginia beat Mercer by 14, Florida beat Detroit 5-4 (+1.5 not needed) and Louisiana won by 21 at UL Monroe. Paid $1.68 on $5 at -297.
history.lesson: A three-leg safety ticket that cashed but pays very little. Florida (Schmid .886) was the shakiest leg and won by one goal.

history.name: Blazers Road Cushion + Rockets Bought-Down
history.whyExplanation: Won: Portland won 120-107 at Sacramento (+1.5 not needed) and Houston beat Utah 125-118, covering -6.5 by half a point.
history.lesson: Blazers +1.5 was the model road-favorite leg: the Kings' home losses were by 11, 13, 15, 6, 7 and 27 (blowouts), and they lost by 13 again. Rockets -6.5 needed Sengun's 43 to clear by half a point vs an 11-straight-loss Jazz team; NBA buy-downs of ~10 points still land near the number, so buy-downs of NBA spreads should keep 10+ points off the main line.

history.name: Knicks Road Cushion + Scarlet Knights Bought-Down

legs.actual: IND 106-104 vs NYK (Knicks lost by 2; needed to lose by 1 or less)

history.whyExplanation: Lost: Rutgers beat Bryant 72-51 (covered -13.5 by 7.5), but Indiana beat New York 106-104 in an NBA Cup game; Knicks +1.5 missed by half a point.
history.lesson: The Pacers' home losses before Friday were by 5, 8, 4 and 12, so they were a competitive home team despite 1-4. Brunson scored 33 but the Knicks lost the second quarter 32-22. Rule: a road favorite on the plus side needs a home team that has been getting blown out at home (most home losses by 10+, like Sacramento). If the bad home team's losses are mostly within 8, skip it. Also, NBA Cup games produced two outright wins by struggling home teams on Friday (Indiana, Chicago).

history.name: Cougars Road Cushion + Hawks Big Cushion

legs.actual: CHI 125-117 OT vs ATL (110-110 after regulation; Bulls won OT 15-7, Hawks lost by 8)

history.whyExplanation: Lost both legs: Colorado beat No. 14 Houston 42-32 (Houston +3.5 lost by 10), and Chicago beat Atlanta 125-117 in overtime (110-110 after regulation, so Hawks +4.5 lost when the Bulls won OT 15-7).
history.lesson: Two road favorites against struggling home teams both lost outright. Colorado ran for 67-, 38- and 32-yard touchdowns at home at night with a coach on the hot seat. College road favorites under two touchdowns carry upset risk that +3.5 does not cover. Chicago's home losses were all by 4-6, which was the warning; we added cushion when we should have skipped. Rules: (1) no CFB road favorite of less than -14 on any side; (2) skip NBA road favorites when the home team keeps losing close at home (same as the Knicks lesson).

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Won 8/8: Florida State by 24, NC State by 19, UCF by 14, TCU by 12, Arkansas by 13, SMU by 25, Liberty by 8 and Tarleton State by 4. Paid $0.65 on $5 at -767.
history.lesson: The tier-gap rule went 8/8 again (23/23 over three Best Shots), but Tarleton (-2800) beat SWAC Alcorn by only 4 and Liberty (-3000) by 8. When the host is itself a low-major (T-Rank 150+), the tier gap is smaller than the price suggests. Tier-gap moneylines now need a host in the top ~150.

history.name: Spurs + Magic Home Cushions

legs.event: Golden State Warriors @ San Antonio Spurs

history.whyExplanation: Won: San Antonio beat Golden State 123-85 and Orlando beat Milwaukee 107-99.
history.lesson: Both clearly-better home favorites cashed. Orlando was 0-4 at home but won by 8 against a 0-5-on-the-road Bucks team. The watch rule is resolved: no tightening needed when the visitor is also winless on the road and point differential favors the home team by 9+.

history.name: Grizzlies Road Cushion + Illini Big Cushion
history.whyExplanation: Won: Memphis won 142-111 at New Orleans, and UCLA beat Illinois 22-14 (+20.5 covered by 12.5).
history.lesson: Road favorite with a 5-0 road record vs a home team that had been blown out at home: an easy cover, the opposite of Chicago/Indiana. The backup-QB fade (points against UCLA's third-string QB in a 47.5-total game) cashed comfortably.

history.name: Canucks Team Under + Bulldogs ML
history.whyExplanation: Won: the Rangers beat Vancouver 5-1 (Canucks scored once), and Drake beat South Dakota 81-72.
history.lesson: A team-total under on the NHL's worst offense instead of a failed goalie-edge +1.5 worked as designed. Drake won by 9 against an 87.5-ppg visitor; moneyline (not a buy-down) was right.

history.name: Best Shot $500K

legs.actual: NSH 3-2 SO at VGK (5 total goals incl. shootout goal)

history.whyExplanation: Won: Heat 133, Cavaliers 121 (254, Over 213.5 by 40.5), and Nashville won 3-2 in a shootout at Vegas (5 goals, Under 8.5). Paid $1.25 on $5 at -400.
history.lesson: The ~90% game-log totals test went 2/2. Short, safe, low payout, as stated.

topLessons: Road favorites on the plus side now need a home-loss check: Portland (+1.5 vs a Kings team losing at home by 11-27) won; Knicks +1.5 and Hawks +4.5 lost to Pacers/Bulls teams whose home losses were all close. Denver +1.5 passes (Pelicans lost their last two home games by 34 and 31).

No CFB road favorites under -14 on any side: Houston (-9.5) lost by 10 at Colorado. Today Alabama (-14.5) is the only CFB road favorite used, at +1.5; ECU, Nevada and Wyoming were skipped despite big SP+ edges.

Buy-down +7 bar on SP+ projections: Liberty -10.5 (SP+ 32), Notre Dame -17.5 (32), Iowa -7.5 (21), Virginia Tech -5.5 (22), Louisiana Tech -7.5 (20), New Mexico -7.5 (20). Boise (SP+ 12 vs -16.5), Clemson (13 vs -15.5) and TCU (5 vs -13.5) failed.

Goalie-edge rule (.025+, favorite starter .910+): Devils (Hellebuyck .916 vs Thompson .889) and Hurricanes (Kochetkov .920 vs Daccord .881) pass. Wild/Bruins (.012) and Avalanche/Canadiens (.023) fail; Panthers fail on starter quality (.901).
Tier-gap moneylines now require a top-150 host: five pass in the Best Shot. East Carolina (T-Rank 175) and Towson (162) were skipped because Tarleton (-2800) only beat Alcorn by 4 on Friday.
Back-to-back opponents are the cleanest NBA edges: both NBA legs today face a team on the second night of a back-to-back (Pelicans, Bulls).
